info.title: Web Business Workflow Test Platform
info.description: FastAPI/PostgreSQL project-isolated API with FastAPI Users database-backed cookie sessions. Business errors use {error:{code,message,details?},requestId}; authentication errors use {code,message}. Lists use limit/offset. All timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. Use credentials: include and proxy /api including WebSockets in development.
